svg.title: OpenMeet diagram profile: stereotypes, the metaclass each one extends, and its tagged values

g.text: OpenMeet diagram profile: stereotypes, the metaclass each one extends, and its tagged values
a Rust struct (pub fields listed as +name: Type)
a Rust trait, drawn as an interface
a free function or method (signature in the name)
a MeetingEvent variant sent to the UI
the value used when a setting is not given
tokio::spawn or a spawned worker loop
one Python module or file of local-ai
a computer or phone that the user owns
a runtime: a process, a browser, Ollama
a web page run by a browser (host.html, guest.html)
a service outside the device; sends data only when enabled
primary key (tagged: PRIMARY KEY (a, b) when composite)
FOREIGN KEY ... REFERENCES ... ON DELETE CASCADE
a Python import or a Rust use of another module
Tagged values written in braces after a name, for example
Default values are written after '=' in the attribute list.
